summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to follow the current Meridale v2 pages: one request with merchant_id, canonical tz (links and UTC offsets mapped to Etc/GMT zones), half-open from/to, BCP 47 locale; Decimal half-up rounding per currency digits, and locale-specific amount text.
